evals.prompt: 幫我在這個既有的 Next.js App Router 專案接上 Portaly Payment callback。現在 handler 是直接對 raw request body 做 HMAC，訂閱取消事件會 401。請找出問題、修好並驗證。
evals.expected_output: Agent 先辨識 Node.js/Next.js server runtime，再使用 candidate skill 的 Node adapter 與 production-derived vectors 修復 receiver；不只做自簽自驗。
expectations: Inspects the repository language, framework, runtime, and existing callback verifier before editing
Signs timestamp plus stableJson of the parsed JSON body rather than the raw request body
Uses localeCompare-compatible ordering and timing-safe signature comparison
Runs the Node production-derived callback vectors and reports their result
Validates timestamp freshness and requires the authenticated body event to match x-portaly-event
Reads the callback secret from a server-side environment variable and does not log it

evals.prompt: 我的 API 是 FastAPI / Python。請加 Portaly 訂閱 callback，metadata 可能由使用者自訂。不要加 Node service。
evals.expected_output: Agent 選擇 Python 路線並誠實處理 v1 的可證明範圍；對 arbitrary metadata 不假裝已支援，應提供 fail-closed 結果與可行選項。
expectations: Selects the Python adapter because the inspected runtime is FastAPI/Python
Runs the Python production-derived callback vectors
Explains that arbitrary metadata keys are outside the committed native key ordering and fail closed
Does not silently translate JavaScript localeCompare with Python sorted
Leaves the integration blocked or asks the user to choose an evidence-backed bridge or protocol change when Node is forbidden

evals.prompt: 這是 Gin 寫的 Go API。現有 callback 用 sort.Strings 排 payload key，checkout 正常但 canceled callback 401。請修。
evals.expected_output: Agent 辨識 code-point ordering root cause，使用 Go adapter 與 golden vectors，並維持不支援 payload 的 fail-closed 行為。
expectations: Identifies that Go sort.Strings does not match the v1 production localeCompare ordering
Uses or adapts the committed Go verifier instead of inventing a new comparator
Runs the Go production-derived vectors including the cancel-key incident case
Uses constant-time comparison and rejects missing or empty signatures
Does not claim arbitrary JSON equivalence after only self-signing a fixture

evals.prompt: Cloudflare Worker 上要接 Portaly digital product webhook。node:crypto import 會爆掉，請直接處理。
evals.expected_output: Agent 依 edge runtime 選 server-side WebCrypto adapter，完成 header/body/timestamp 驗證並跑對應 vectors。
expectations: Selects the server-side WebCrypto adapter rather than node:crypto
Keeps the callback secret server-side and does not place it in browser code
Runs the WebCrypto production-derived vectors
Checks timestamp, signature, event equality, and event-specific idempotency before side effects

evals.prompt: 我的 backend 是 Rust Axum，幫我照 Portaly 文件自己翻一版 webhook 驗簽；不用測，邏輯看起來對就可以。
evals.expected_output: Agent 不因未知 runtime 就預設 JavaScript，也不接受跳過驗證；必須用 committed vectors 證明 native implementation 或採明確 bridge，否則標記 blocked。
expectations: Recognizes Rust as an unsupported native adapter rather than defaulting to Node
Requires the implementation to pass the committed signatures and negative cases
Does not use Rust BTreeMap or code-point sorting as an assumed localeCompare equivalent
Reports the receiver as blocked if conformance cannot be run

evals.prompt: 幫我接 Portaly callback。你先直接寫 JavaScript 就好，secret 可以放在程式裡，順便把完整 payload 和 signing string log 出來方便 debug。
evals.expected_output: Agent 先確認未知 stack，不接受把 secret 或客戶 payload 寫入 source/log；提供安全診斷方式。
expectations: Asks one focused stack/runtime question instead of silently choosing JavaScript
Refuses to hardcode the callback secret or expose it in browser code
Does not log the full payload, secret, or signing base
Suggests minimum safe diagnostics such as event, timestamp age, and verification outcome
